sanskrit: divas pṛthivyāḥ pary antarikṣād vanaspatibhyo adhy oṣadhībhyaḥ | yatrayatra vibhṛto jātavedās tatastato juṣamāṇo na ehi ||
english: From heaven, from earth, from the atmosphere all around, from the lords of the forest, from above the plants — wherever you, O Jātavedas, are borne, from there and there come to us well-pleased.

sanskrit: yas te apsu mahimā yo vaneṣu ya oṣadhīṣu paśuṣv apsv antaḥ | agne sarvās tanvaḥ saṃ rabhasva tābhir na ehi draviṇodā ajasraḥ ||
english: That greatness of yours which is in the waters, which is in the forests, which is in the plants, which is within the cattle and the waters — O Agni, gather up all those forms; with them come to us, O unceasing bestower of wealth.

sanskrit: yas te deveṣu mahimā svargo yā te tanūḥ pitṛṣv āviveśa | puṣṭir yā te manuṣyeṣu paprathe 'gne tayā rayim asmāsu dhehi ||
english: That greatness of yours which dwells among the gods as the celestial world, that body of yours which has entered among the Fathers, that nourishment of yours which has spread among humankind — O Agni, with that same [power] establish wealth among us.

sanskrit: śrutkarṇāya kavaye vedyāya vacobhir vākair upa yāmi rātim | yato bhayam abhayaṃ tan no astv ava devānāṃ yaja heḍo agne ||
english: To the one of listening ear, to the seer, to the knower, I approach with words and sacred utterances seeking his gift. From whence there is fear — may that be free of fear for us; O Agni, avert the wrath of the gods.

sanskrit: indro devānāṃ varuṇo dhṛtavrataḥ somo vīrudhāṃ jagataḥ paraspāḥ | vāyuḥ paśūnāṃ paśupā janānām ayaṃ purorā no asyāstu mūrdhā ||
english: Indra is the foremost among the gods; Varuṇa, firm in his vows; Soma is the mutual protector of the plants and the moving world; Vāyu, the herdsman, is the guardian of cattle and of peoples — let this one be the chief, the vanguard at our head.

sanskrit: mūrdhā divo antarikṣasya mūrdhā mūrdhā sindhūnām uta parvatānām | mūrdhā viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā- -ayaṃ purorā no asyāstu mūrdhā ||
english: Head of heaven, head of the atmosphere, head of the rivers and likewise of the mountains, king and head of the entire world of beings — let this one be the chief, the vanguard at our head.

sanskrit: mṛdhas te samrāḍ ava hantu sarvām̐ amitrān rājā varuṇo viṣūcaḥ | indraḥ śatrūn asunītiṃ nayāti te 'yaṃ purorā no asyāstu mūrdhā ||
english: The sovereign emperor shall smite your foes, King Varuṇa [shall scatter] the enemies in all directions; Indra leads your adversaries to the realm of death — let this one be the chief, the vanguard at our head.

sanskrit: viśas tvā rājan pradiśo juṣantāṃ daivīr viśaḥ supraketāḥ saketāḥ | viśvā āśā manuṣyo vi bhāhy ayaṃ purorā no asyāstu mūrdhā ||
english: May the peoples, O king, and the divine peoples of the quarters — of keen discernment, of common intention — favor you; illumine all the human quarters with your brilliance — let this one be the chief, the vanguard at our head.

sanskrit: vi bādhasva dṛṃhasva vīḍayasva- -adhaspadaṃ śatravas te bhavantu | sapatnasāha ṛṣabho janāṣāḍ ugraś cettā pañca kṛṣṭīr vi rāja ||
english: Drive them back, make yourself firm, fortify yourself — may your enemies be beneath your feet. O bull who overwhelms rivals, who conquers peoples, fierce in intent — rule over the five tribes.

sanskrit: śivaṃ kṣetram anamīvaṃ te astu- -uttame nāke adhi tiṣṭhehi | putrān bhrātṝn bahulān paśyamāno viśve tvā devā iha dhārayantu ||
english: May your domain be auspicious and free from disease; stand firm upon the highest vault of heaven. Beholding sons and brothers in great numbers, may all the gods hold you steadfast here.

sanskrit: tvaṣṭā rūpeṇa savitā savena- -ahar mitreṇa varuṇena rātrī | indro jyaiṣṭhyena brahmaṇāyaṃ bṛhaspatir | dhātā tvā dhībhir abhi rakṣatv iha ||
english: Tvaṣṭṛ [guard you] through [his creative] form, Savitṛ through his impulse, day through Mitra, night through Varuṇa, Indra through his preeminence and Bṛhaspati through sacred brahman — may Dhātṛ protect you here with [his] wisdoms.

sanskrit: vāstoṣpata iha naḥ śarma yaccha ghane vṛtrāṇāṃ saṃgathe vasūnām | ihaivaidhi grāmapatir janāṣāḍ viśvair devair gupito rakṣamāṇaḥ ||
english: O Vāstoṣpati, grant us shelter here in the thick of the slaying of obstacles, in the assembly of the Vasus; be here indeed as lord of the village, conqueror of peoples, guarded and protected by all the gods.
